## Action sequence — next moves (post-rescore)

### Highest-leverage REMAINING IMPROVE band

1. **Flash** (11/21, IMPROVE-or-cut) — deferred Phase 0 salvages: SR-scheduled surfacing on session start (+1 Spacing) + cross-lesson Flash stream (+2 Interleaving). Projected 11 → 14, crosses into KEEP-salvageable.
2. **Conversation** (7/21, REMOVE-as-standalone per user) — execute the settings-toggle-off-by-default removal path OR ship the deferred in-tab gates (predict-before-reveal + read-to-schedule). User's verdict update suggests removal is the call.

### Reflection-tier IMPROVEs (unchanged from pre-rescore — never actioned in this campaign)

3. **Streak Map** (3/6) — capture per-day missed lessonIds + drill-routing button + extend pass/miss classifier for new event types (`L2-struggle-pass`, `walkthrough-quiz-miss`, `flash-blank`, `notes-to-code-pass`) so the heatmap doesn't decay in informativeness as surface coverage grows. → 6/6.
4. **Mistake Tagging** (4/6) — tap-route Stats aggregator pills + tag-grain Today's Plan slot. → 6/6.

### KEEP, salvageable upper-band polish (Phase 5+ cleanup)

5. **11 retrieval tools at 14-17/21** all have specific deferred edits documented in their audits. Each is +1-2 single-dim lift. Bundle as a Phase 5 "feedback-quality polish" pass per the original IMPROVEMENT-PLAN.

## Cross-cutting findings (refreshed)

1. **Salvage paths delivered as projected.** All 16 actioned tools moved in the predicted direction; 4 crossed band boundaries (3 promoted to ship-quality, 1 jumped two bands). The campaign lifted the **median retrieval-tool score from 14 → 17**.

2. **Streak Map regression flagged.** New history event types added during the campaign (`L2-struggle-pass`, `walkthrough-quiz-miss`, `walkthrough-bug-miss`, `notes-to-code-pass`, `flash-blank`) increment `bucket.total` but the pass/miss classifier in `08-drills-bughunt-constraint.js:32-33` is closed-set on the original 4 event types. Net effect: growing surface coverage makes the heatmap LESS informative over time. Edit-1 sub-task added to streak-map salvage path.

3. **Reflection tools remain ship-quality but didn't benefit from richer history.** None of the 8 ship-quality reflection tools read `state.history` directly — they consume `state.reviews`, `state.weakness`, `state.revealed`. So the new event types flow to `appendHistory` but don't reach the reflection layer except via Streak Map (which has the classifier bug above). Not a regression, but a missed opportunity.

4. **Recognition-tier ceiling holds.** Predict, Claim, Recognize, Trace, Reverse, Warmup, Rapid-Fire stayed Encoding 1/3 as expected — all MC-tier by structure. Lifting Encoding past 1/3 requires free-text variants (Phase 6 architectural decision in original plan).

5. **Gotcha → Crux transformation is a meta-finding.** While Phase 2B only specified a guarded SR-write for Gotcha, the tool was substantively re-built into a 2-mode drill (Easy MC + Hard typed-recall). +5 in one cycle — the biggest single-tool lift of the campaign. Worth flagging as a model for other recognition-tier salvages.

- Phase 4 (streak-map + mistake-tagging) — both still IMPROVE, both have small deferred edits.

- Phase 6 (recognition-tier ceiling lift via free-text variants) — needs user decision.
